EC1: - Known liver disease before total pancreatectomy [OR] or pancreaticoduodenectomy (excluding NAFLD)
EC2: - Severe co-morbid disease (besides from the indication for the pancreas surgery)
EC4: - Any condition that the investigator feels would interfere with the safety of the trial participation or the safety of the subject
EC6: Percutaneous liver biopsy exclusion criteria (to be evaluated before last visit)
EC11: - Skin infection in area where biopsy will be sampled
